item.title: Christmas: Northern CAN urges Tinubu, governors to ensure safety of lives, property
item.description: The Christian Association of Nigeria, CAN, in the 19 northern states and the Federal Capital Territory, FCT, has called on President Bola Tinubu, northern state governors and the Minister of the FCT to take urgent and decisive measures to guarantee the safety of lives and property during the Christmas celebrations and beyond. The appeal was […] Christmas: Northern CAN urges Tinubu, governors to ensure safety of lives, property

item.title: Tinubu to present 2026 budget without accounting for 2025 fiscal year – BudgIT
item.description: BudgIT, a civic organization, has alleged of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s move to present the 2026 budget of N54.4 trillion before the National Assembly without accounting for the 2025 budget performance report. BudgIT made this known in a statement on X on Thursday. item.title: NSA tasks Governors, police on special security
item.description: Nigeria’s National Security Adviser (NSA), Nuhu Ribadu, has urged state governors to tighten security as the festive season approaches. The advice was shared with governors through the Nigeria Governors Forum (NGF) and confirmed in a communiqué issued after the forum’s 7th meeting of 2025 in Abuja. item.title: FCT traditional rulers back Tinubu, hail Wike’s projects
item.description: Traditional rulers in the Federal Capital Territory (FCT) have pledged their support for President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s re-election in 2027, saying residents of satellite towns are seeing real government impacts for the first time in many years. item.title: Jigawa approves N91bn for roads, power, others

item.title: AFCON 2025: Super Eagles intensify preparation in Fez
item.description: The Super Eagles will intensify preparations for the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations with two training sessions on Friday (today), DAILY POST reports. item.title: Police bust fake kidnapping syndicate, arrest five suspects in Lagos
